custom_subsystem.name: acrobatics
custom_subsystem.definition: May tumble behind opponents to enable backstabs.

procedure.step: In lieu of moving during a round, attempt a proficiency throw to tumble behind an opponent in melee.
Reduce the required throw by 1 per level of experience possessed.
If successful, the nightblade moves behind the opponent.
The opponent loses the benefit of any shield.
The nightblade may backstab the opponent, gaining +4 to the attack throw and bonus damage based on level.
